Ravi (People Ops): Heads-up: we're piloting a lighter "stack calibration" approach for speed this cycle. Goal: reduce total live time while keeping alignment. Please skim and comment.
Sofia (Manager): Sounds good. What's the expected duration per session?
Ravi (People Ops): Plan is 45m org micro-sessions + 60m cross-stack sync. We know people have meetings so we'll offer 3 stagger windows/day.
Jordan (Eng): Can a single manager cover two adjacent stacks if they own both teams?
Ravi (People Ops): Yes, but only if they can cover both reviews without conflict. Use the "stack-pair" checkbox in the sign-up sheet: https://rwd.co/calib-stack-pilot
Priya (Manager): Is there a short "note to attach" for reviewers to explain rating shifts? Want to keep auditability minimal.
Ravi (People Ops): Use this 1-line guideline inside the review comment box: `Cal note: evidence + impact + suggested outcome`. If more context needed, paste 2-3 bullets.
OpsBot: Reminder: sign-ups close in 72h. If your slot is unfilled, People Ops will auto-assign a floater.
Sofia (Manager): What about external hires/new managers who haven't used the rubric?
Ravi (People Ops): We'll pair them with a buddy for their first micro-session. Mark "need buddy" on the sheet and we'll match.
Jordan (Eng): Contractors that are conversion candidates: are they elevated differently?
Priya (Manager): We discussed this: conversions go through org micro, then an ad-hoc conversion panel before cross-stack, because headcount/budget needs checking.
Ravi (People Ops): Two important policy bits: 1) embargo on publishing ratings until the final cross-stack sync completes — DO NOT leak. 2) reviewers should not add final numeric scores in shared docs until the embargo lifts. Embargo lifts 2026-04-10 08:00 UTC.
Jordan (Eng): If someone is forced to swap out last-minute, what's the handoff payload?
Ravi (People Ops): Minimal handoff: name of reviewer -> assigned reviews -> link to last 2 feedback notes. Paste this in the backfill column. We'll remind with a template DM.
Priya (Manager): Can we record the cross-stack sync? Some folks are remote and might miss nuance.
Ravi (People Ops): Recordings allowed but must be set to org-internal and deleted after 30 days. Add a short TLP note in the session doc.
Sofia (Manager): Any guidance on promo nomination caps?
Ravi (People Ops): Same caps as last cycle. If you think someone is an exception, raise with @people-ops BEFORE cross-stack; include promotion business case (3 bullets).
OpsBot: Posted: facilitator checklist and one-slide rubric summary in https://rwd.co/calib-stack-pilot/docs :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Eng): TY. Signing up now.
Ravi (People Ops): Thanks all — we'll send a short pre-read PDF and the facilitator script tonight. Ping @people-ops with any escalations.
